name: muster-codex-plugin
description: Show live terminal activity, complete-file change context, and an evidence-backed Kanban in Codex without patching the app.

interface.shortDescription: See complete files and coordinate agent work
interface.longDescription: Muster Live Work adds Codex skills for full-file change visibility and evidence-backed task orchestration, plus an optional local companion for existing pinned tasks. It stores state outside repositories and never patches the signed Codex app, task history, or updater.
defaultPrompt: $muster-live Show every command and the complete file after each edit.
$muster-board Create a board from the tasks in this prompt.
$muster-live $muster-board Work visibly and coordinate independent tasks.
